cenas.editar: Photorealistic full-frame photo, 9:16 vertical. No people, no hands. No phone frame, no device bezel, no borders, no added text. Bright modern living room with a light wood floor and soft neutral daylight, sofa softly blurred in the background. An open plain white dog training pad (quilted absorbent center, thin border, like the pad under the dog in reference photo 2) lies flat on the floor, centered slightly LEFT, between 45% and 62% of the image height, with a small blue liquid stain in its center. The RIGHT third of the floor is empty. No bag or packaging anywhere, no text, no letters, no logos, no printing on the pad or anywhere in the image.
cenas.movimento: Static camera on a tripod, the camera does not move. The blue liquid soaks into the pad and disappears, the surface turns dry.
